about: Completion's triggers as a Sheet answers them with its own Linked Tables (ExSheet ticket 39, ADR-0058, SH-36): the columns after Table[, the list again after Backspace, and the values each list writes, evaluated. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' CompletionTriggerTests.

cases.name: ADR-0058 / ADR-0047 (2026-10-10): SUBTOTAL's and AGGREGATE's lists write only a number the engine evaluates, never one it refuses (each number and option the lists in completion-trigger.json write, over 1, 2 and 4)

ADR-0058 / ADR-0047, SH-36: each value the lists write is a mode the engine evaluates, not the #VALUE! of a mode it does not know (a binary search over data sorted as it says, 1, 2 ascending in A and 2, 1 descending in C)
